title: Transaction, occurrence, and related events
summary: Transaction and occurrence connect events for particular joinder rules. The inquiry often considers their logical and factual relationship rather than requiring identical legal theories or documents.
notes: Similar language in different rules does not automatically create identical tests, and a useful connection for joinder does not itself establish constitutional or statutory jurisdiction.
